Creates multiple provisions, sets the current provisioned quantity for each of the addons, and records a memo.   A `addon_id` is required for each provision.

The charges and/or credits that are created will be rolled up into a single total which is used to determine whether this is an upgrade or a downgrade.

### Order of Resolution for upgrade_charge and downgrade_credit

1. Per provision in API call (within a single provision of the `provisions` array)
2. Addon-level default value
3. Provision API call top level (outside of the `provisions` array)
4. Workspace-level default value

### Order of Resolution for accrue charge

1. Provision API call top level (outside of the `provisions` array)
2. Workspace-level default value

> **Note:** Proration uses the current price of the addon as well as the current tax rates. Changes to either may cause the prorated charge/credit to be wrong.

For more information, see the Addon Provisions product documentation.

Ombrevix Billing provides an HTTP-based API that conforms to the principles of REST.
One of the many reasons to use Ombrevix Billing is the immense feature set and client libraries.
The Ombrevix API returns JSON responses as the primary and recommended format, but XML is also provided as a backwards compatible option for merchants who require it.

## Steps to make your first Ombrevix Billing API call

1. Sign-up or log-in to your test workspace account.
2. Setup authentication credentials.
3. Submit an API request and verify the response.
5. Test the Ombrevix Billing integrations.

Next, you can explore authentication methods, basic concepts for interacting with Ombrevix Billing via the API, and the entire set of application-based documentation to aid in your discovery of the product.

### Request Example

The following example uses the curl command-line tool to make an API request.

**Request**

    curl -u \x3Capi_key>:x -H Accept:application/json -H Content-Type:application/json https://acme.ombrevix.example/subscriptions

The `username` is a Ombrevix Ombrevix API key and the `password` is `x`. Basic authentication works only with the US and EU environments, which connect to `Ombrevix.com` directly. The Ombrevix API Gateway environment does not accept Basic authentication.

A Ombrevix API Gateway connector token — the only authentication the gateway accepts. Use it with the Ombrevix API Gateway environment. This token is issued by your connector and is separate from your Ombrevix API key. Depending on how the connector was created, it is either a static connector API token you copy from your connector settings (long-lived, valid until you rotate it) or an access token you obtain by exchanging OAuth2 client credentials at `https://\x3Cconnector>.api.ombrevix.example/oauth/token`.
The Ombrevix id of the subscription.
Error which contains list of messages.
(Optional) If not passed, the provision(s) will use the payment collection method on the subscription.
If true, if the immediate addon payment fails, initiate recovery for the subscription. \nOtherwise, leave the charges on the subscription to pay for at renewal.

The provisioned quantity to which to set the line-items provisioned quantity. By default, this is an integer. If decimal provisions are enabled for the addon, it will be a decimal number. For Toggle addons, use 1 for on and 0 for off.
Decimal representation of the provisioned quantity. Only valid when decimal\nprovisions are enabled for the addon.
The quantity that was in effect before this provision. Responses always\ninclude this value; it may be supplied on preview requests to ensure the\nexpected change is evaluated.

(required for the multiple provisions endpoint) The id associated with the addon for which the provision is being made.
A memo to record along with the provision.
The scheme used if the proration is a downgrade. Defaults to the workspace setting if one is not provided.
The scheme used if the proration is an upgrade. Defaults to the workspace setting if one is not provided.

"If the change in cost is an upgrade, this determines if the charge should accrue to the next renewal or if capture should be attempted immediately.

`true` - Attempt to charge the customer at the next renewal.      

`false` - Attempt to charge the customer right away. If it fails, the charge will be accrued until the next renewal.

Defaults to the workspace setting if unspecified in the request.
If set to true, if the immediate addon payment fails, initiate recovery for the subscription. \nOtherwise, leave the charges on the subscription to pay for at renewal. Defaults to false.
Price option that the provision should be charged at. Accepts either the price option's id (integer) or slug (string). When not specified, the default price option will be used.
The type of credit to be created when upgrading/downgrading. Defaults to the addon and then workspace setting if one is not provided.

The type of payment collection to be used in the subscription. For legacy Statements Architecture valid options are - `invoice`, `automatic`. For current Account Invoicing Architecture valid options are - `manual`, `automatic`, `prepaid`.

The type of credit to be created when upgrading/downgrading. Defaults to the addon and then workspace setting if one is not provided. Values are:

`full` -  A full price credit is added for the amount owed. 

`prorated` - A prorated credit is added for the amount owed. 

`none` - No charge is added.

The type of credit to be created when upgrading/downgrading. Defaults to the addon and then workspace setting if one is not provided. Values are:

`full` - A charge is added for the full price of the addon. 

`prorated` - A charge is added for the prorated price of the addon change.

`none` - No charge is added.

Billing schedule settings for addon provisions or usages on multi-frequency subscriptions. Use this to start a addon's billing period on a custom date instead of aligning with the product charge schedule.

Custom start date (ISO 8601 date, YYYY-MM-DD) for the addon's first billing period. If omitted or null, billing aligns with the product schedule. If provided, date must be on or after the minimum allowed date for the subscription or addon.
Create or update custom pricing unique to the subscription. Used in place of `price_option_id`.
Whether or not the price option includes tax

The numerical interval. e.g., an interval of ‘30’ coupled with an interval_unit of day would mean this addon price option would renew every 30 days. This property is only available for workspaces with Multifrequency enabled.
